who: Eugene Donald Levy, historian of American and Pittsburgh industrial history, Carnegie Mellon 1965–1999; PhD Yale 1970.

notes: Full name, degree, institution, employment dates and research area agree with the supervisor of Cole's 1994 Homestead dissertation.
